name: Disallow messaging and calling
description: Main action: user will not be able to message (SMS/MMS) or call anybody. This action is not deletable.

name: Allow messaging and calling
description: Main action: user will be able to call and message anybody. This action is not deletable.

name: Disallow installing apps
description: Main action: user will not be able to install any applications on the device. This action is not deletable.

name: Allow installing apps
description: Main action: user will be able to install any application. This action is not deletable.

name: Lock unknown sources
description: Main action: block installing apps from unknown sources (sideload). This action is not deletable.

name: Unlock unknown sources
description: Main action: allow installing apps from unknown sources (sideload). This action is not deletable.

name: Disallow using camera
description: Main action: user will not be able to use the camera of the device. This action is not deletable.

name: Allow using camera
description: Main action: user will be able to use the camera of the device. This action is not deletable.

name: Block camera apps
description: Main action: block common camera app packages using suspend/hide (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Unblock camera apps
description: Main action: unblock common camera app packages using suspend/hide (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Block custom camera app packages
description: Main action: block provided camera packages (csv). This action is not deletable.

name: Disallow screen capture
description: Main action: user will not be able to take screenshots / screen record. This action is not deletable.

name: Allow screen capture
description: Main action: user will be able to take screenshots / screen record. This action is not deletable.

name: Disable status bar expand
description: Main action: prevent pulling down / expanding status bar (best-effort via reflection). This action is not deletable.

name: Allow status bar expand
description: Main action: allow pulling down / expanding status bar (best-effort via reflection). This action is not deletable.

name: Turn Wi-Fi off
description: Main action: turns Wi-Fi off. This action is not deletable.

name: Turn Wi-Fi on
description: Main action: turns Wi-Fi on. This action is not deletable.

name: Disallow changing Wi-Fi
description: Main action: user cannot configure/toggle Wi-Fi settings (DO/PO restriction). This action is not deletable.

name: Allow changing Wi-Fi
description: Main action: user can configure/toggle Wi-Fi settings (DO/PO restriction). This action is not deletable.

name: Keep Wi-Fi on
description: Main action: if user turns off Wi-Fi, turn it on again. This action is not deletable.

name: Keep Wi-Fi off
description: Main action: if user turns on Wi-Fi, turn it off again. This action is not deletable.

name: Disable Wi-Fi enforce
description: Main action: disable Wi-Fi enforcement. This action is not deletable.

name: Turn off the Bluetooth
description: Main action: turn off the Bluetooth as fast as possible. This action is not deletable.

name: Turn on the Bluetooth
description: Main action: turn on the Bluetooth as fast as possible. This action is not deletable.

name: Keep Bluetooth On
description: Main action: if user turns off Bluetooth, turn it on again. This action is not deletable.

name: Keep Bluetooth Off
description: Main action: if user turns on Bluetooth, turn it off again. This action is not deletable.

name: Disable Keep Bluetooth
description: Main action: disable keep Bluetooth on/off enforcement. This action is not deletable.

name: Disallow turning Bluetooth on
description: Main action: user will not be able to turn on the Bluetooth (DO/PO restriction). This action is not deletable.

name: Allow turning Bluetooth on/off
description: Main action: user will be able to turn Bluetooth on/off (DO/PO restriction). This action is not deletable.

name: Disallow changing GPS/Location
description: Main action: user cannot toggle location settings (DO/PO restriction). This action is not deletable.

name: Allow changing GPS/Location
description: Main action: user can toggle location settings (DO/PO restriction). This action is not deletable.

name: Turn GPS/Location on
description: Main action: try enabling location services (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Turn GPS/Location off
description: Main action: try disabling location services (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Keep GPS/Location on
description: Main action: if user turns off location, try turning it on again (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Keep GPS/Location off
description: Main action: if user turns on location, try turning it off again (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Disable GPS/Location enforce
description: Main action: disable GPS enforcement. This action is not deletable.

name: Enable airplane mode
description: Main action: attempt to enable airplane mode (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Disable airplane mode
description: Main action: attempt to disable airplane mode (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Enable hotspot
description: Main action: attempt to enable Wi-Fi hotspot/tethering (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Disable hotspot
description: Main action: attempt to disable Wi-Fi hotspot/tethering (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Enable cellular data
description: Main action: attempt to enable mobile data (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Disable cellular data
description: Main action: attempt to disable mobile data (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Enable data roaming
description: Main action: enable data roaming (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Disable data roaming
description: Main action: disable data roaming (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Enable NFC
description: Main action: attempt to enable NFC (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Disable NFC
description: Main action: attempt to disable NFC (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Enable ADB
description: Main action: attempt to enable ADB (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Disable ADB
description: Main action: attempt to disable ADB (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Set USB config to mtp,adb
description: Main action: set sys.usb.config (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Set USB config to none
description: Main action: set sys.usb.config to none (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Block web access (browsers)
description: Main action: block web usage by suspending/hiding selected packages (DO/PO required). This action is not deletable.

name: Unblock web access (browsers)
description: Main action: unblock web usage by unsuspending/unhiding selected packages (DO/PO required). This action is not deletable.

name: Disallow sending/receiving SMS/MMS (AppOps best-effort)
description: Main action: attempt to block SMS send/receive via AppOps (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Allow sending/receiving SMS/MMS (AppOps best-effort)
description: Main action: attempt to allow SMS send/receive via AppOps (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Turn speakerphone on
description: Main action: enable speakerphone. This action is not deletable.

name: Turn speakerphone off
description: Main action: disable speakerphone. This action is not deletable.

name: Set audio profile: Normal
description: Main action: set ringer mode to NORMAL. This action is not deletable.

name: Set audio profile: Vibrate
description: Main action: set ringer mode to VIBRATE. This action is not deletable.

name: Set audio profile: Silent
description: Main action: set ringer mode to SILENT. This action is not deletable.

name: Create notification (text only)
description: Main action: show a high-priority notification with title and body. This action is not deletable.

input.title: MDM Notice
input.body: This is a sample notification without image.

name: Create notification (with image + tag)
description: Main action: show a high-priority notification with big picture style. This action is not deletable.

input.title: MDM Notice
input.body: This is a sample notification with image.

name: Install APK from URL
description: Main action: download an APK and install it using pm (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Remove APK by package id
description: Main action: uninstall an app by its package name (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Deploy file to path
description: Main action: download file from URL and save to device path. This action is not deletable.

name: Remove file by path
description: Main action: delete a single file at path. This action is not deletable.

name: Copy file
description: Main action: copy a file from source to destination. This action is not deletable.

name: Cut (move) file
description: Main action: move a file from source to destination. This action is not deletable.

name: Delete file/folder recursively
description: Main action: delete a file or directory recursively. This action is not deletable.

name: Ping device
description: Main action: check device connectivity; returns PONG timestamp. This action is not deletable.

name: Lock screen now
description: Main action: immediately locks the device screen (Device Admin required). This action is not deletable.

name: Wipe device
description: Main action: factory reset (Device Admin required). This action is not deletable.

name: Get last known location
description: Main action: report last known GPS location (permission required). This action is not deletable.

name: Inventory report
description: Main action: report device info and installed packages count. This action is not deletable.

name: Full lock (kiosk-like best-effort)
description: Main action: tries to disable keyguard features, camera, screen capture, and locks device (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Enable actions execution
description: Main action: enable client-side action execution (except restrictions where noted). This action is not deletable.

name: Disable actions execution
description: Main action: disable client-side action execution (Ping and ActionTypeEnabled still work). This action is not deletable.

name: Reset Wi-Fi enforcement
description: Main action: reset Wi-Fi enforcement mode to NONE. This action is not deletable.

name: Reset Bluetooth enforcement
description: Main action: reset Bluetooth enforcement mode to NONE. This action is not deletable.

name: Reset GPS enforcement
description: Main action: reset GPS enforcement mode to NONE. This action is not deletable.

name: Reset Wi-Fi policy restriction
description: Main action: clear DISALLOW_CONFIG_WIFI restriction (DO/PO required). This action is not deletable.

name: Reset Bluetooth policy restriction
description: Main action: clear DISALLOW_BLUETOOTH restriction (DO/PO required). This action is not deletable.

name: Reset GPS policy restriction
description: Main action: clear DISALLOW_CONFIG_LOCATION restriction (DO/PO required). This action is not deletable.

name: Reset camera policy
description: Main action: re-enable camera via policy (Device Admin required). This action is not deletable.

name: Reset screen capture policy
description: Main action: allow screenshots via policy (Device Admin required). This action is not deletable.

name: Reset status bar policy
description: Main action: allow status bar expand via reflection (best-effort). This action is not deletable.

name: Internal storage enabled (allow USB transfer/media)
description: Main action: clear USB file transfer + mount physical media restrictions (DO/PO required). This action is not deletable.

name: Internal storage disabled (block USB transfer/media)
description: Main action: apply USB file transfer + mount physical media restrictions (DO/PO required). This action is not deletable.

name: Enable TLS mode
description: Main action: set internal flag use_tls=true (client should read ConfigStore.useTls()). This action is not deletable.

name: Disable TLS mode
description: Main action: set internal flag use_tls=false (client should read ConfigStore.useTls()). This action is not deletable.

name: Allow deploy actions
description: Main action: set internal flag allow_deploy=true (optional gate for deploy actions). This action is not deletable.

name: Disallow deploy actions
description: Main action: set internal flag allow_deploy=false (optional gate for deploy actions). This action is not deletable.

name: Create VPN profiles (placeholder enabled)
description: Main action: placeholder; logs warning because no profile payload exists. This action is not deletable.

name: Create VPN profiles (disabled)
description: Main action: placeholder disabled (no-op). This action is not deletable.

name: Set password quality: Numeric
description: Main action: enforce numeric-only password quality (Device Admin required). This action is not deletable.

name: Set password quality: Complex
description: Main action: enforce complex password quality (Device Admin required). This action is not deletable.

name: Set minimum password length
description: Main action: enforce minimum password length (Device Admin required). This action is not deletable.

name: Set minimum uppercase letters
description: Main action: enforce minimum uppercase letters (Device Admin required; reflection). This action is not deletable.

name: Set minimum lowercase letters
description: Main action: enforce minimum lowercase letters (Device Admin required; reflection). This action is not deletable.

name: Set minimum numeric digits
description: Main action: enforce minimum numeric digits (Device Admin required; reflection). This action is not deletable.

name: Set minimum non-letter characters
description: Main action: enforce minimum non-letter characters (Device Admin required; reflection). This action is not deletable.

name: Set minimum symbols
description: Main action: enforce minimum symbols (Device Admin required; reflection). This action is not deletable.

name: Set maximum time to lock
description: Main action: set maximum idle time before lock (Device Admin required). This action is not deletable.

name: Set maximum failed attempts for wipe
description: Main action: wipe after N failed password attempts (Device Admin required). This action is not deletable.
